subtitles.en: Book of the Watchers (1 Enoch chapters 1–36)

descriptions.en: **Planned** Wheel of Heaven Translation of 1 Enoch, scoped to the Book of the Watchers (chapters 1–36). Phase 5 priority. Source: Charles 1912 critical edition (Public Domain) as base reference; Knibb 1978 and Nickelsburg 2001 (Hermeneia) as scholarly references (copyrighted). The Watchers narrative (chapters 6–11) is the most directly WoH-resonant material in the pseudepigrapha and is named in the Raëlian canon's commentary section as one of the texts closer to its truth.
